modules.module_title: Understanding Properties of Hydrogen from safety point of view & Safe handling of Hydrogen

pcs.pc_description: Ensure that personnel under their supervision have a deep understanding of hydrogen's properties, including its flammability, explosive limits and potential hazards.
Ensure personal and team adherence to the use of appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work conditions
Identify and communicate the relevant documents, responsible individuals, and designated locations pertaining to health and safety in the workplace, facilitating effective safety management.
Oversee and participate in risk assessments specific to hydrogen storage, handling and production processes.
Proficiently identify hydrogen process hazards and assess risks including the analysis of risk or accident in the workplace due to hydrogen leak/fire
capability to accurately read and interpret data from sensing equipment used in hydrogen production processes
apply key safety parameters for handling hydrogen & oxygen
Evaluate hydrogen release pressures and understand hydrogen flame detection methods, emphasizing the colorless nature of hydrogen flames
Apply critical safety requirements for electrical equipment used in green hydrogen production, minimizing electrical hazards
competent in the operation and functioning of hydrogen exhaust systems, facilitating the safe removal of hydrogen from the workplace
Execute inertization processes using nitrogen to displace hazardous gases enhancing safety in hydrogen-related operations
Proficiently identify and recognize common safety signs displayed in various areas, promoting a safe work environment.
safely handle and manage lye solution (KOH solution), ensuring the prevention of accidents and injuries
carry out safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure the safety of self and others
Enforce the use of safety guidelines and procedures that consider hydrogen's unique properties.
Competently manage hydrogen ignition sources to prevent potential incidents and enhance workplace safety.

Adhere to standard practices for the safe venting of hydrogen and oxygen, referencing applicable industry standards and performance requirements for equipment and hoses, ensuring safe gas handling procedures.

modules.module_title: Ensure the following fire safety procedures

pcs.pc_description: Ensure the personal and team Familiarization with Hydrogen Leak and flame detection system, Identification of Hydrogen Fire; use the various appropriate fire extinguishers on different types of fires correctly
Develop and implement measures to mitigate hydrogen fire, isolation of Hydrogen supply line and lead the team in following rescue techniques applied during fire hazard
Promote and enforce following good housekeeping practice in order to prevent fire hazards
Regularly inspect work areas for compliance with housekeeping standards
identify and document issues concerning the hydrogen safety in work place
Collaborate with relevant departments to address and rectify safety concerns promptly
Ensure that work areas and escape routes are well maintained and free from any hindrance
Establish and communicate a system for personnel to report any near-miss incidents to the fire safety department and provide the necessary guidance and resources for reporting and investigation
Lead by example in consistently following and enforcing the applicable laws, regulations and codes as per safety standard
Ensure that personnel are trained in preparing comprehensive accident/incident reports
Review and approve written accident/incident reports before sharing them with the concerned officer or department to facilitate proper documentation and follow-up actions

modules.module_title: Follow emergencies, rescue and first-aid procedures

pcs.pc_description: provide appropriate first aid to victims during emergency situations, ensuring prompt and effective response to injuries or medical issues
Be proficient in basic techniques of bandaging
Lead by example in responding promptly and appropriately to an accident
perform rescue activity during an accident in real or simulated environments
Familiarize personnel with correct escape routes during an emergency
demonstrate correct method to rescue injured people and others during an emergency

Ensure that personnel are familiar with emergency protocols, including evacuation and shutdown procedures and verify that the team understands and can implement these protocols effectively in case of emergencies.

modules.module_title: oversee activities related to Green Hydrogen production process

pcs.pc_description: Determine the startup, shutdown, parameter adjustments and performance monitoring to ensure optimal electrolysis
Supervise the startup and monitoring of the power supply system including renewable energy sources to ensure efficient operation
Oversee and regulate the water supply to the electrolyzer, maintaining consistent operation
Control and monitor the water purification system, including filters, deionization units or reverse osmosis systems to uphold required water quality standards
Oversee the operation of gas purification systems to effectively remove impurities from hydrogen gas
Determine and oversee gas separation processes, such as pressure swing adsorption (PSA) or membrane separation, to ensure the production of pure hydrogen gas
Monitor storage tanks or cylinders to guarantee proper storage conditions for the produced hydrogen gas
Report production logs, findings and faults promptly to superiors for appropriate action
Ensure strict compliance with safety and quality standards throughout the entire process of green hydrogen production
Maintain daily operational reporting and promptly report incidents, near misses and findings to superiors
Continuously monitor and uphold safety & quality standards during all phases of green hydrogen production
Supervise the maintenance and recording of critical electrolyzer parameters such as electrolyte flow, temperature, current, hydrogen flow rate and pressure parameters
Manage the monitoring of periodic cleaning- in-place (CIP) records and proper maintenance of the rejected water from reverse osmosis (RO) through a zero liquid discharge scheme
Ensure adherence to generic SOP to maintain safety and operational efficiency
Apply basic knowledge of Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for hazardous substances like KOH, H2, and O2
Supervise the safe collection of laboratory samples as needed for quality control purposes
Effectively lead emergency response actions and troubleshooting efforts to ensure operational continuity and safety
